answer: The willow graph is validated at intake and the trellis frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and nebula anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Duplicating the work 33 times multiplies the fee by 121 and leaves every copy exposed to a single slash, so the downside scales faster than the headcount. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
